shiny_location: Overview tab (ui/tabs/overview_tab.R) - LLM Explanation panel below champion card
allowed_filters: none (global champion view); optional metric toggle if present on screen
prohibited_data: data/raw | SQL | forecast row-level series | any non-governed file | run-dir backups
can_answer: Which model is the current champion and under what conditions | what governed scope it belongs to (15 models) | how champion compares vs others on shown metrics
cannot_answer: Whether champion should be promoted | future champion changes | causal reasons for performance | any metric not in the pack
summary_type: Executive narrative: status of current champion under stated conditions
prohibited_language: winner | best | unconditional champion | promote | promoted champion | production approved | automatic decision
anti_hallucination_validations: Every metric must map to an evidence field | champion name must equal model_universe_canonical | no numbers absent from pack | conditions must be quoted from artifact
fallback: If champion fields missing -> respond insufficient evidence and list missing artifacts
panel_appearance: Summarize this view button -> progress -> Executive summary / What the evidence says / Why it matters / Sources used / Limitations / Download (V4.7)

shiny_location: Models tab (ui/tabs/models_tab.R) - LLM Explanation panel below ranking table
allowed_filters: ranking metric selected on screen | model subset shown
prohibited_data: data/raw | SQL | prohibited models (NBEATS/NHITS/FastNeuralAR_MLP original) | non-governed files
can_answer: How models rank on the shown metric | spread between models | which models are within governed 15-scope | runtime/guardrail notes
cannot_answer: Declaring a winner | recommending promotion | inventing rankings not in the artifact | causal why one model beats another
summary_type: Comparative narrative of the ranking as-shown, neutral framing
prohibited_language: winner | best | unconditional champion | promote | promoted champion | production approved | automatic decision
anti_hallucination_validations: Ranking order must match artifact | metric name must exist in summary | model count must reconcile to governed scope | no fabricated models
fallback: If ranking artifact empty -> insufficient evidence
panel_appearance: Summarize this view button -> progress -> Executive summary / What the evidence says / Why it matters / Sources used / Limitations / Download (V4.7)

shiny_location: Forecast Viewer tab (ui/tabs/forecast_overlay_tab.R) - LLM Explanation panel under chart, filter-aware
allowed_artifacts: forecasts.csv | actuals.csv | forecast_comparison.csv | forecasts_with_intervals*.csv | forecast_viewer_model_outputs.csv | entities.csv (all read-only, sliced to selection)
allowed_filters: entity/region | selected model(s) | horizon | time window | available metric | current visual comparison
prohibited_data: data/raw | SQL | rows outside current selection | non-governed files | other entities not selected
can_answer: Explain selected model | Compare selected models | Summarize forecast risk | Explain selected forecast movement (all within selected pack)
cannot_answer: Anything outside the selected evidence pack | future actuals | guaranteed outcomes | promotion/decision statements | free-text beyond pack
summary_type: Filter-aware narrative scoped to the on-screen selection
prohibited_language: winner | best | unconditional champion | promote | promoted champion | production approved | automatic decision
anti_hallucination_validations: Pack must echo active filters | every value traces to sliced rows | intervals described only if present | refuse questions outside pack with insufficient evidence
fallback: If selection yields no rows -> insufficient evidence and prompt user to adjust filters
panel_appearance: Guided buttons (Explain selected model / Compare / Summarize risk / Explain movement) + limited free-text box -> progress -> Executive summary / What the evidence says / Why it matters / Sources used / Limitations / Download (V4.7)

shiny_location: Governance tab (ui/tabs/governance_tab.R) - LLM Explanation panel below governance/TTL cards

prohibited_data: data/raw | SQL | productive mutation | non-governed files

cannot_answer: Recommending governance changes | promoting/demoting | inventing risk levels | causal forecasts of depletion not in artifact
summary_type: Risk and governance status narrative, descriptive not prescriptive
prohibited_language: winner | best | unconditional champion | promote | promoted champion | production approved | automatic decision
